title: MOBI (Mobipocket) signature
summary: A MOBI ebook begins with the 4-byte signature 'BOOK' (0x42 0x4F 0x4F 0x4B) or 'TPZ' (0x54 0x50 0x5A) for Topaz format. MOBI is based on PDB (Palm Database) format.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: MOBI is based on Palm Database (PDB) format.
MOBI is used by Amazon Kindle (older format, superseded by AZW3/KFX).
MOBI supports DRM, annotations, and metadata.
